title: Bistable traveling fronts in strong shear flows: speed and profile asymptotics
summary: We study the strong-shear limit of bistable traveling fronts in infinite cylinders with periodic transverse boundary conditions. We prove that, for every sufficiently regular periodic shear profile, the front speed normalized by the flow amplitude converges as the amplitude tends to infinity. After suitable longitudinal rescaling and translations, the corresponding profiles converge along subsequences to full fronts of the limiting degenerate equation.
